title: The Motes Beneath the Bridge
opening: Evening settles over Hemlock Village. Blue motes gather beneath the old bridge, where the wood gives a low, familiar creak.

opening_dialogue.text: Evening settles over Hemlock Village. Blue motes gather beneath the old bridge, where the wood gives a low, familiar creak.
Renn—look. They are moving against the wind. That is either very clever pollen, or not pollen at all.
And something crossed under the southern rail. The tracks stop where the light begins.
The motes drift closer. Renn, what do you do?

prompt_message: The motes drift against the wind and collect around the southern rail.
freeform_hint: Describe anything Renn says, attempts, investigates, or asks the others to do.

creature_prompt.title: The Crown Hare is watching
creature_prompt.message: The creature remains at the fern line. Soren waits beside Renn while Lupin watches the trail behind them. What does Renn say or do?

creature_success.shared_text: The Crown Hare lowers its head. The motes gather around its paws, then spill into a narrow path leading deeper beneath the bridge.
creature_success.private_text: Renn recognizes the gesture as an invitation rather than surrender.
creature_success.journal: With Soren and Lupin beside him, Renn gained the Crown Hare's trust. It revealed a hidden route beneath the bridge.

dialogue.text: It likes you. I knew it would—though I reserve the right to be jealous if it gets the first hug.
Then we follow together. I will take the rear; Soren, stay where Renn can see you.
Side by side, the three Hazels step from the Lantern Road. The Crown Hare leads them toward a door of roots and blue light beneath the bridge.
dialogue.performance: warm forward motion and quiet wonder

creature_failure.shared_text: The Crown Hare startles back, but does not flee. It leaves three luminous prints pointing beneath the bridge.
creature_failure.private_text: The creature is wary, not hostile. Another careful approach may earn its trust later.
creature_failure.journal: The Crown Hare kept its distance but marked a hidden route beneath the bridge with three luminous tracks.

dialogue.text: Easy. You did not lose it—it is still listening. We can give it room.
Those prints are deliberate. It wants us to notice the way under the bridge, even if it is not ready to lead us.
With Soren close and Lupin guarding the path, Renn turns toward the three glowing tracks. The way forward remains open.

choices.label: Call the party closer and watch

success.shared_text: The motes tighten into a luminous trail beneath the bridge. For one breath, the forest seems to listen.
success.private_text: A whisper reaches Renn alone: “Do not trust the lantern keeper.”
success.journal: Blue motes gathered beneath the southern bridge and formed a trail. A private warning named the lantern keeper.

dialogue.text: There—a path. Renn, they answered you.
Keep your eyes on the bank. We are not the only ones following it.
A small crowned silhouette slips from the fern line. Gold-tipped ears rise above the luminous trail, and an ancient little gaze settles on Renn.

creature.name: Crown Hare
creature.summary: A watchful forest hare with gold-tipped ears, glimpsed beside the motes.

failure.shared_text: The motes flare and scatter into the trees. The bridge settles into silence before their pattern becomes clear.
failure.private_text: Renn cannot yet determine what drew the motes to the bridge.
failure.journal: Blue motes gathered beneath the southern bridge, then scattered before their pattern could be understood.

dialogue.text: Wait. Do not chase them—there is still one light beneath the rail.
And fresh tracks beside it. Small, four-footed, heading toward the fern line.
The scattered glow leaves one clue behind: the brief outline of long ears watching from the brush.
dialogue.performance: quiet mystery with a softened landing

creature.name: Crown Hare
creature.summary: Only a long-eared silhouette is known; it watched from the fern line.
